verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API that assigns users to variants for experiments, rollouts and releases, and its marketing describes running tests and rollouts alongside analytics. That is a first-party flagging capability. However, nothing in the evidence says flags can be targeted by user properties or cohorts, or rolled out by percentage. Cohorts appear only in an analytics context. Missing for 10: documented targeting rules by user properties, cohort-based flag targeting, percentage rollout controls, SDK evaluation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
